memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Mild intermittent asthma, glaucoma, hypothyroidism.
Symptoms: occasional wheeze after exertion, no night symptoms. Eye: no visual change, using timolol and latanoprost as prescribed. Energy normal, no weight change.
Examination: respiratory rate 16, breath sounds bilaterally clear, no wheeze. Eyes: pupils equal, reactive, no conjunctival injection.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.40 L (88% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; change from baseline +0.02 L.
Asthma Control Test score 22 (well controlled).
Technique checked: correct.
Smoking status: never.
Plan: Continue salbutamol metered-dose inhaler as needed. Continue timolol 0.5% eye drops BD and latanoprost 0.005% eye drops HS. Levothyroxine 50 mcg OD. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 100 mcg, 2 puffs PRN wheeze
levothyroxine sodium 50 mcg, take 1 tablet daily
timolol maleate 0.5% eye drops, instill 1 drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops, instill 1 drop in each eye at bedtime

Smoking: never.
Plan: Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD. Continue glaucoma drops and salbutamol PRN. Recheck TSH in 6 weeks.
